references.text: The original instruction for making the table of showbread with its poles, utensils, and the showbread.
Bezalel makes the table of showbread with all its utensils in accordance with God's command.
Moses sets up the table in the tabernacle and arranges the bread before the Lord's presence.
The regulations for the showbread that were to be placed on the table every Sabbath.
Instructions for how the Levites were to cover the table of showbread when the tabernacle was moved.
Solomon makes the gold table for the showbread for the temple in Jerusalem.
The priests place the showbread on the clean table as part of proper worship.
The book of Hebrews describes the furnishings in the first tent, including the table and the showbread.
The instruction in chapter 35 is specified and completed in chapter 39.
Connects the original construction of the showbread to their ongoing liturgical use in later times.
Explains the practical execution of the carrying poles mentioned in the source verse.
